data.narrative:
Sagar Defence Engineering is a Series A-stage defense and security company that has raised $25.4M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 11 companies in the Defense & Security sector at Series A and Series B stages, comprising 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Singularity.

Two triangulation methods were applied. The stage-progression method, using total capital raised as a proxy for Series A valuation, applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier to derive an implied valuation of $51M. The peer-median approach examines the 11-company comparable set, which shows a median valuation of $1.0B with a range from $125M to $3.0B. Sampled peers at Series B include Dream Security ($3.0B), Allen Control Systems ($2.2B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), and Twenty ($1.0B).

The two methods produce a triangulated valuation range of $43M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $525M. The wide dispersion reflects heterogeneity within the defense tech sector—early-stage companies show material variance in market reception and technology maturity. Key uncertainties include the target's revenue traction, proprietary IP defensibility, and regulatory pathway clarity, which would materially narrow the range and inform positioning within the peer distribution.
